frequency_question: How often do central banks announce incremental liquidity-absorption ratio measures within a specified future window given current observation states?
membership_rule: Includes any formal central bank announcement and implementation of a secondary or incremental reserve ratio targeting excess liquidity, excluding standard baseline reserve ratio adjustments.

cases.name: Bank Indonesia secondary reserve requirement adjustment 2018
Bank of Korea liquidity adjustment window 2022

provenance_note: claims 20 cases from only 5 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 5 representative cases named from a broader category of ~20 emerging market liquidity-management tightening episodes over the last decade.
known_gaps: Varies by specific central bank statutory frameworks and differing definitions of excess liquidity.
skeleton: Total observed liquidity-absorption policy cycles across major emerging market central banks facing sudden surplus liquidity surges over 10 years
multiplier: 5 observed instances with comparable precursor visibility out of 20 analogous liquidity surge episodes
validity_reason: Central bank liquidity management frameworks evolve slowly over multi-year horizons.
